title: A Second Goodbye to You.
description: What is the truth behind the disappearance and death of his best friend? And what is the secret hidden in the painting? The start of a horrifying time-lapse suspense story! A Second Goodbye to You. ,Kimi ni Nidome no Sayonara wo., Kimi ni Nidome no Sayonara o. , Un second au revoir (French), 君に二度目のさよならを。
